description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] `altText` edits image descriptions: a string for one image or an ordered array for carousel slides; refused after booking. Edits a draft in place; only the fields you pass change. Any media field replaces the draft's media as a set (keeps the id, so queue items still point at it). Refused (409) for archived or already-published items, and a media swap is refused once a queue booked it. `labels`, `opus`, `videoWatermarked`, `library` and `aiGenerated` may be changed on published items too. `aiGenerated` is the post's AI label: false for real footage, null back to automatic. More optional arguments, not listed: credits, youtube, youtubeAbTestResult, imageContentIds, videoUrl, imageUrl, platforms, text, videoStorageId, imageStorageId, platformText, opus, images, labels. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"update_content"}.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/content/{id}.)

aiGenerated.description: Format: boolean or null; e.g. false.

altText.description: Format: JSON; e.g. "Example". Several shapes; describe_tool shows them.

library.description: Format: object; e.g. {"title":"Summer collection"}. Fields: title, description.

videoWatermarked.description: Format: object or null; e.g. {"version":1}. Fields: version, at.

name: update_content
title: Edit a draft
